name: Nishiarai
tagline: Tokyo in 34 minutes and Otemachi in 36 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Adachi City, where Tobu run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 36 minutes to Otemachi, 47 minutes to Shinjuku, 57 minutes to Shibuya and 48 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 1.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 1.5 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 1.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 0.5 m to 2 m, a difference of 1.5 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 3 to 5 m. All nine points within 400 m of the station fall inside the area too, and the deepest projection among them is 3 to 5 m. For storm surge, 4 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the large side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: イトーヨーカドー アリオ西新井店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 5 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 米倉脊椎・関節病院, about 33 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 東京女子医科大学附属足立医療センター, about 36 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Tobu Skytree Line and Tobu Daishi Line. Both lines are run by Tobu, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together.
congestion: Tobu Skytree Line runs at 142% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 小菅→北千住, which this station is not on. Tobu Daishi Line is not covered by the ministry's congestion survey. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥110,000 to ¥120,000 and 2LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. What holds the figure down: a large projected flood depth. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Daishimae is ahead on the number of medical facilities, but Nishiarai is ahead on the number of lines and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nishiarai. Daishimae has only the Tobu Daishi Line, so Nishiarai is the better connected. To Toranomon, for instance, Daishimae takes 7 minutes longer. On the number of medical facilities, though, Daishimae comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: Umejima is ahead on quiet, but Nishiarai is ahead on the number of lines and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nishiarai. Umejima has only the Tobu Skytree Line, so Nishiarai is the better connected. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. On safety, though, Umejima comes out ahead.

noiseSources: 環七通り (2 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 8 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.

leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
